title: Measure current-main complexity and calibrate anti-circumvention governance
objective: Execute the first ADR-031 repository-step-13 packet: regenerate the exact 113-package complexity baseline, inventory equivalent manifest/source bypasses, classify central systems by role, measure representative change cost and publish calibration inputs without structural remediation.
deliverables: fresh exact-head 113-package dependency depth, fan-in, fan-out, public-surface, central-LOC and CI baseline
complete initial inventory of direct lint tables, source allow/expect attributes and ignored Rust tests
role-aware central-system map for contracts, SDK, runtimes, infrastructure, aggregation and process host
representative ordinary-capability, new-owner and contribution-aggregation change-cost measurements
calibration policy records warning and blocking candidates without authorizing remediation
new complexity-governance paths have exact affected-scope ownership and live workflow compatibility
acceptance: the analyzer runs deterministically on the exact pull-request head with full git history
the report distinguishes stable contract or SDK fan-out from mutable implementation and composition risk
all equivalent Rust lint suppression forms currently required by ADR-031 are inventoried
representative historical change costs are reported in files, packages, central files and workflow files
affected-scope classification requires the real Complexity Baseline workflow for the new analyzer and policy
the first packet changes no product behavior, dependency, package, route, contract, schema, migration or runtime composition
repository step 13 remains in progress and structural remediation remains blocked until this measurement is accepted
non_goals: remove the three registered direct lint exceptions
change Customer Privacy behavior or Phase 8A readiness
claim repository step 13 or architecture 10/10 complete
